source_evidence: You can find a firm’s relationship summary using our  “Check Out Your Investment Professional” search tool at Investor.gov.
question: Misconception: You can only find a firm’s relationship summary by asking the firm directly.
answer: You can also find it through Investor.gov’s “Check Out Your Investment Professional” search tool: select “firm,” search for the firm, choose “Get Details,” and then click “Relationship Summary.”
